Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 CH VARCHAR2(100);
 begin

 :P_LIC_TYPE:=:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE;
 :P_LIC_NBR :=:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR;
 
 

 IF :P_LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :P_LIC_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND 
 :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE<>2 AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD<>4 THEN
 IF :P_LIC_TYPE IN (2,5) THEN
 SELECT BKM.BRKR_NAME BRKR_NAME INTO :BRKR_NAME
 FROM BRKR_MSTR BKM
 WHERE BKM.PORT_CD = 99 AND
 BKM.LIC_TYPE = :P_LIC_TYPE AND
 BKM.LIC_NBR = :P_LIC_NBR;
 ELSE
 
 SELECT BKM.BRKR_NAME BRKR_NAME INTO :BRKR_NAME
 FROM BRKR_MSTR BKM
 WHERE BKM.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD AND
 BKM.LIC_TYPE = :P_LIC_TYPE AND
 BKM.LIC_NBR = :P_LIC_NBR;

 END IF; 
 
 
 ELSE 
 :BRKR_NAME:=NULL;
 :P_LIC_TYPE:=NULL;
 :P_LIC_NBR := NULL;
 
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :BRKR_NAME:=NULL;
 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: LIC_TYPE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE LIC_TYPE IS
 V_RG_ID RECORDGROUP;
 
BEGIN
 V_RG_ID := FIND_GROUP('GROUP_TYPE4');
 IF ID_NULL (V_RG_ID) THEN
 V_RG_ID := CREATE_GROUP_FROM_QUERY ('GROUP_TYPE4', 'SELECT RV_MEANING,
 TO_CHAR(RV_LOW_VALUE)
 FROM CG_REF_CODES WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''LICENSE TYPE''');
 END IF;
 IF POPULATE_GROUP (V_RG_ID) = 0 THEN
 POPULATE_LIST ('P_LIC_TYPE',V_RG_ID);
 END IF;
END;

/******************************************************************************************************/
-- UPDATE CHECK_VAL
-- DESCRIPTION: TO CHECK ON THE FLAG PAY_WITHOUT_PRNIT AND UPDATE PRINT_CNT AND NEED_PRINT
-- PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARF HASHIM EXT.: 4295
-- VERSION : 1.0
-- DATE : 28-02-2005
/******************************************************************************************************/

PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER ; 
 H_DATE DATE ;
 V_VAL VARCHAR2(100);
 Y NUMBER (7);
 X NUMBER (7);
G_DATE DATE ;
G_DATE2 DATE ;
P_DCLTN_FLAG NUMBER ;
P_CURR_PORT_CD NUMBER ;
RECORD_COUNT NUMBER(3);
I NUMBER(3);
RET NUMBER;
BEGIN

 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN:=NULL;
GO_ITEM('DCLTN_ISN');
LAST_RECORD;
 RECORD_COUNT:=TO_NUMBER(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD) ;
FIRST_RECORD;

 FOR i IN 1..RECORD_COUNT LOOP
 
 IF :DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 /*
 IF TO_NUMBER(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD)>1 AND :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN:=:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN||' , '||:DCLTN_ISN;
 ELSE
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN:=' '||:PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN||:DCLTN_ISN;
 END IF;
 */
 VALIDATE_DCLTN_NBR;
 :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN := :DCLTN_ISN;
 -- BY SHERIFT UPON M.ABO ELFTOUH REQ.
 CHECK_PAY_WITHOUT_PRNT;
 --
 -- ADD_ACTIVITY; ----> No need for the ACTIVITY, This procedure for display only, not for printing.
 ----> So, we pass the 'DISABLEPRINT' Parameter to the report (only in this procedure) while 
 ----> Creating The Parameter_List.
 END IF;
 
 
-----------------------------------------------------------------
 IF :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 
 IF :P_PORT_CD IS NULL THEN 
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD ;
 ---------------------------------
 ELSE
 
 P_CURR_PORT_CD := :P_PORT_CD ;
 END IF;
 ------------------------------------
 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 --- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- ---
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DISABLEPRINT',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); --> Be carefull only in CHECK_VAL Procedure
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DISABLEMAIL',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); --> Be carefull only in CHECK_VAL Procedure 
 --- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- ---
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_ISN',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 
 /*IF :P_DCLTN_TYPE IN (1,2)THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER, 0);
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
 END IF;*/
 
 IF :DCLTN_STATUS IN (5,9) AND :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD = 10 THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, 'نسخة المستورد');
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 END IF; 
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_NO);
 --IF :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE<>2 AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD<>4 THEN
 IF :P_LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :P_LIC_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_LIC_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_LIC_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_LIC_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_LIC_TYPE);
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_LIC_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_LIC_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 END IF;
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 NEXT_RECORD;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END LOOP;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END ;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_PAY_WITHOUT_PRNT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/******************************************************************************************************/
-- NEW CHECK_PAY_WITHOUT_PRNT 
-- DESCRIPTION: TO CHECK ON THE FLAG PAY_WITHOUT_PRNIT AND UPDATE PRINT_CNT AND NEED_PRINT
-- PROGRAMMER : SHERIF TAHA SHARF HASHIM EXT.: 4295
-- VERSION : 1.0
-- DATE : 27-02-2005
/******************************************************************************************************/

PROCEDURE CHECK_PAY_WITHOUT_PRNT IS
 V_REVENUE_CHNGD NUMBER;
 V_PAY_WITHOUT_PRINT NUMBER;
 V_CL_VAL NUMBER;
 V_CALC_DT DATE;
 V_PAYER VARCHAR2(1000);
 TXT VARCHAR2(300); 
 MSG_LVL VARCHAR2(5);
 V_NEED_PRNT NUMBER:=0 ;
BEGIN
 V_CALC_DT := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;
 V_PAYER := DCLTN.GET_DCLTN_PAYER_NAME(:P_PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN);
 MSG_LVL := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '25';
 V_REVENUE_CHNGD := DUTY.CALC_DCLTN_FEES(:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE, :P_PORT_CD, :DCLTN_ISN, V_CALC_DT, V_PAYER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, :PARAMETER.P_WS_ID, NULL, 1, V_CL_VAL,TXT);
 V_PAY_WITHOUT_PRINT :=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('PAY_WITHOUT_PRINT',999),0);
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := MSG_LVL;
 IF V_PAY_WITHOUT_PRINT = 1 THEN
 IF V_REVENUE_CHNGD >= 0 THEN
 
 IF :DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 IF NOT (:DCLTN_STATUS IN (9,5) AND :PMT_METHOD IN (1,2)) THEN
 V_NEED_PRNT := 0;
 ELSE
 V_NEED_PRNT := 1; 
 END IF;
 ELSE
 V_NEED_PRNT := 0;
 END IF; 
 
 
 IF V_NEED_PRNT = 0 THEN
 
 UPDATE DECLARATIONS 
 SET PRINT_CNT = (DECODE(NVL(PRINT_CNT,0),0,1,PRINT_CNT))
 , NEED_PRINT=0
 WHERE PORT_CD = :P_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN ;
 ELSE
 UPDATE DECLARATIONS 
 SET PRINT_CNT = (DECODE(NVL(PRINT_CNT,0),0,1,PRINT_CNT))
 WHERE PORT_CD = :P_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN ;
 
 END IF; 
 
 ELSE--IF V_REVENUE_CHNGD = -1 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن حساب رسوم البيان - راجع الحاسب الآلي','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
END;

PROCEDURE VALIDATE_DCLTN_NBR IS

 v_cnt NUMBER;

 AC_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_DEC_DHL NUMBER;
BEGIN
 
 
 IF (:DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL) /*AND (:DCLTN_DT IS NULL)*/ THEN
 
 --SELECT DCLTN_ISN,TO_CHAR(DCLTN_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'),DCLTN_STA_CD
 IF :P_LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN,DCLTN_DT,DCLTN_STA_CD,PMT_METHOD,DCLTN_TYPE_CD,DEC_DHL
 INTO :DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_DT,DSC,:PMT_METHOD,:DCLTN_TYPE_CD,V_DEC_DHL
 FROM DECLARATIONS 
 WHERE (PORT_CD = :P_PORT_CD) AND 
 DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR AND
 (DCLTN_DT =:DCLTN_DT OR :DCLTN_DT IS NULL) AND
 (DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN OR :DCLTN_ISN IS NULL) AND
 ( (DCLTN_STA_CD = 5) OR (DCLTN_STA_CD = 9 AND :P_PORT_CD = 10) OR (DCLTN_STA_CD = 1 AND :P_PORT_CD <> 10)
 OR (DCLTN_STA_CD = 3 AND :P_PORT_CD IN (83,95,34) ) 
 ----APPDEV109--
 OR (NVL(DEC_DHL,0)= 1 AND :P_PORT_CD IN(11,20,23) ) 
 ----APPDEV109--
 ) AND 
 --INSPTR_ID IS NULL AND
 (
 (LIC_TYPE = :PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE AND
 LIC_NBR = :PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR AND
 BRKR_PORT_CD = DECODE(LIC_TYPE,2,99,5,99,1,:P_PORT_CD,BRKR_PORT_CD) AND
 :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE<>2 AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD<>4)
 OR (:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR IS NULL)
 OR
 (:PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE=2 AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD=4)
 );
 ELSE
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN,DCLTN_DT,DCLTN_STA_CD,PMT_METHOD,DCLTN_TYPE_CD,DEC_DHL
 INTO :DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_DT,DSC,:PMT_METHOD,:DCLTN_TYPE_CD,V_DEC_DHL
 FROM DECLARATIONS 
 WHERE (PORT_CD = :P_PORT_CD) AND 
 DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR AND

 (DCLTN_DT = :DCLTN_DT OR :DCLTN_DT IS NULL) AND
 (DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN OR :DCLTN_ISN IS NULL) AND
 DCLTN_STA_CD IN (3,4,5,7,15) AND 
 --INSPTR_ID IS NULL AND
 (
 (LIC_TYPE = :PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE AND
 LIC_NBR = :PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR AND
 BRKR_PORT_CD = DECODE(LIC_TYPE,2,99,5,99,1,:P_PORT_CD,BRKR_PORT_CD) AND
 :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE<>2 AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD<>4)
 OR (:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR IS NULL)
 OR
 (:PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE=2 AND :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD=4)
 );
 END IF;
 
 -- BY SHERIFT 01-03-2005
 IF :P_LIC_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF DSC = 3 AND :P_PORT_CD IN(83,95,34) 
 ----APPDEV109--
 OR ( NVL(V_DEC_DHL,0)= 1 AND :P_PORT_CD IN (20,11) )
 ----APPDEV109--
 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE 
 IF ( (DSC <> 5) AND (DSC <> 9 OR :P_PORT_CD <> 10) AND (DSC <> 1 OR :P_PORT_CD = 10) AND (:P_PORT_CD <> 23)) THEN 
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(21,961,'ERROR');
 :DCLTN_ISN:=NULL;
 :DCLTN_DT :=NULL;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF DSC NOT IN (3,4,5,7,15) THEN 
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(21,961,'ERROR');
 :DCLTN_ISN:=NULL;
 :DCLTN_DT :=NULL;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 ----- 
 BEGIN

 P_KEY := :P_PORT_CD || '!' || :DCLTN_ISN;
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO AC_COUNT FROM ( SELECT * FROM ACTIVITY_TRANSACTIONS WHERE ACTVY_SUB_ID = P_KEY ) DEC_ACT_1
 WHERE SYSOBJ_ID = 21 AND SUBJ_CODE = 1 AND ACTVY_TYPE = 81 ORDER BY ACTVY_ISN DESC;
 
 IF NVL(AC_COUNT,0) > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('تم طباعة طلب التحضير والعاينة لهذا البيان مرة واحدة بعد السداد','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 

 END;
 ------
 :DCLTN_STATUS := DSC;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
-------------------------------------------------------
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(21,967,'ERROR');
 --BY SHERIFT
 :DCLTN_NBR := NULL;
 :DCLTN_DT := NULL;
 :DCLTN_ISN := NULL;

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
--------------------------------------------------------

PROCEDURE ADD_ACTIVITY IS
 V_PRINT NUMBER;
 V_DCLTN_STA NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :DCLTN_STATUS IN (5,9) THEN -----1
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 81, :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 ELSE-----1
 
 SELECT INSP_REP_PRINT_CNT , DCLTN_STA_CD
 INTO V_PRINT , V_DCLTN_STA
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN;
 
 IF NVL(V_PRINT,0) = 0 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 55, :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 56, :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 
 END IF;-----1
 
 UPDATE DECLARATIONS 
 SET INSP_REP_PRINT_CNT = NVL(INSP_REP_PRINT_CNT,0) + 1
 WHERE PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN;
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT'); 
 END IF;
END;
